title: 3 Strangers Bid Their Own Years For 1 Real Wish
description: The winner pays in age: bid thirty years and you walk out thirty years younger. How many years would you bid for one real wish? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Kitsune: tall white fox spirit standing upright, white fur, calm amber eyes, long dark red kimono with a plain black obi, holds one round glowing paper lantern, no hat, no mask
characters.Saki: 19-year-old Japanese woman, shoulder-length brown hair with straight bangs, oversized mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans, white canvas sneakers, small plain paper lantern in her lap, no hat
characters.Hideo: 45-year-old Japanese man, short black hair graying at the sides, thin mustache, rumpled gray suit, white shirt, loosened plain navy tie, brown leather shoes, small plain paper lantern in his lap, no hat, no glasses
characters.Chiyo: 81-year-old Japanese grandmother, tiny and hunched, white hair in a neat low bun, round kind face with deep smile lines, plain lavender kimono with a gray haori jacket, white tabi socks, wooden geta, small plain paper lantern in her lap, no hat, no glasses
characters.Young Chiyo: the same Chiyo turned 11 years old, Japanese girl, black hair in the same neat low bun, round face with the same kind smile, the same plain lavender kimono and gray haori now loose on her, white tabi socks, wooden geta, no hat
characters.Kazuo: 13-year-old Japanese boy (her husband made young), short messy black hair, the same old man's brown cardigan hanging loose over a white undershirt, baggy gray trousers rolled up, bare feet, no hat, no glasses

scenes.say: Three strangers bid their own years for one real wish. The winner pays in age. Bid thirty years, and you walk out thirty years younger.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, lit only by warm lantern light, Kitsune stands at a low wooden counter and raises one round glowing paper lantern. [4-7s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of the lantern in Kitsune's paw, a soft golden light slowly swirling inside it. [7-10s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, medium shot of Saki, Hideo and Chiyo sitting on low wooden stools in a row, staring up at the glowing lantern.

scenes.say: The fox has two rules. You must stay at least one year old. And bid more years than you own, your lantern goes out and you float home.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of Kitsune holding up two clawed fingers, amber eyes calm. [4-7s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of Saki's and Hideo's hands each holding a small plain paper lantern glowing softly in their laps. [7-10s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, medium close-up of Chiyo smiling quietly and rubbing her small wrinkled hands together.

scenes.say: Saki is nineteen, so her limit is eighteen. Hideo is forty-five. Grandma Chiyo is eighty-one and only says her husband Kazuo waits at home with a bad knee.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, medium shot of Saki biting her thumbnail nervously, her small lantern glowing in her lap. [4-7s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, Hideo loosens his tie and leans forward on his stool, eyes fixed on the big lantern. [7-10s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of Chiyo speaking softly with a fond little smile, her small lantern glowing in her lap.

scenes.say: Bidding opens at five. Saki jumps to eighteen, then panics and shouts twenty-five. Her lantern goes dark, and she drifts up through the roof like a soap bubble.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, Saki shoots her hand up eagerly from her stool. [4-7s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of Saki's small paper lantern going dark in her hands, her face dropping in shock. [7-10s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, Saki floats gently up off her stool, sweater sleeves drifting, rising through the shadowy wooden rafters while Hideo stares up open-mouthed.

scenes.say: So it's Hideo against Grandma. He climbs to forty-four, his whole limit, sweating. Chiyo raises one hand and calmly says seventy. Nobody in the hut breathes.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of Hideo raising his hand, sweat on his forehead, jaw clenched. [4-7s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, medium shot of Chiyo calmly lifting one small wrinkled hand from her lap. [7-10s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, close-up of Kitsune's amber eyes widening slightly, the big lantern glowing brighter in its paw.

scenes.say: Eighty-one minus seventy: Chiyo is eleven. She wishes Kazuo loses seventy too. At home, a thirteen-year-old boy jumps out of his armchair. Three strangers bid years for one wish.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small wooden auction hut at a quiet misty spirit night market, golden light wraps around Chiyo and she becomes Young Chiyo, an eleven-year-old girl in the same loose lavender kimono, staring at her small smooth hands. [4-7s] Inside a small old 1990s Japanese living room at night, Kazuo, now a thirteen-year-old boy in a loose brown cardigan, leaps up out of a worn armchair, laughing in disbelief. [7-10s] On a narrow wooden footbridge over a misty river at night, Young Chiyo runs across in her geta, grinning, lantern light behind her.
